scenario: LCON.2.6.1 integer determinism — arithmetic right shift, negative value. `-8 >> 1` is -4 (sign-preserving / arithmetic shift per LEXP.7.14.1), not a large positive (logical / zero-fill shift). Guard `(t.x >> 1) == -4` gates the emit; fact_count 2 confirms the bit-exact value.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x >> 1) == -4
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
